message.content: [罪名]放火罪未遂;非法携带危险物品罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The facts: Defendant Xiao carried gas canister and lighter into office, opened gas valve then closed, lit lighter then extinguished, then after persuasion he gave up lighting again, let victims leave. He waited at scene after report, no resistance, confessed. Police seized gas canister and lighter.

Potential crimes: Attempted arson? He opened gas valve, lit lighter (but extinguished). Did he actually cause fire? He attempted to cause fire but didn't succeed. Under Chinese criminal law, "故意放火罪" (arson) requires actual fire causing damage. Attempted arson is "未遂" of arson, which is punishable as "放火罪未遂". So could be "放火罪未遂". Also "非法携带易燃易爆危险物品罪"? He carried gas canister and lighter into a public place. There's a crime "非法携带危险物品罪" (illegal possession of dangerous goods). However Chinese law: "非法携带枪支、弹药、爆炸物、易燃易爆危险物品" etc. He had gas canister (likely not regulated?) Might be "非法携带易燃易爆危险物品罪". Also "扰乱公共场所秩序罪"? He threatened safety. But the core is attempted arson.

He also "在明知他人报案的情况下仍在现场等待" - not a crime.

Thus likely "放火罪未遂". Also maybe "非法持有、使用危险物品罪". The law: Article 138 of Criminal Law: "非法制造、买卖、运输、储存、携带、使用危险物质" etc. So carrying gas canister and lighter could be "非法携带危险物品罪". But need to see if gas canister is regulated. Usually LPG cylinder is regulated. So yes.

Thus answer: [罪名]放火罪未遂;非法携带危险物品罪<eoa>
